sub_indicators.label: Off-site backup for government systems
sub_indicators.subject: infra.store
sub_indicators.text: Off-site backup capacity: off-site backup for government systems
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Smart Africa Data Center and Cloud Blueprint asks that e-government run on a Tier-classified primary site with a secondary site for disaster recovery.
criteria: A source from the past three years says government systems have no off-site backup or disaster-recovery site.
A ministry, agency or the central bank keeps its systems or data at a backup site in service, 200 km or more from its main site or abroad.
A backup site 200 km or more away serves the government's shared systems: the national data centre or government cloud.
A recovery plan or a failover test from the past three years is on record for that backup site.
The government's main data centre and its backup site are both Tier III or above.

aspects.name: A backup site 200 km or more away in service, and for the shared government systems
A recovery plan or test on record
Primary and backup both Tier III
